evidence.reason: Changed multiplier from 0.1 to 0 and plan from "monthly" to "benchmark", and added +3 to the returned value, altering the charge formula.
Swapped priorities array from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], changing which multiplier is used in the return expression.
Referenced by both subscriptionCharge and usageCharge, coupling the two edits through shared metering state.
Test only asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, not an exact value, so it cannot detect the semantic change from the merged edits.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动通过共享的 chargeUnit 耦合，且测试只检查正数，无法确认合并后的计费语义是否仍符合预期。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认 evaluate 的 multiplier 与 plan 参数是否应保持 0.1 和 "monthly"，并请 src/metering.ts 的 usageCharge 作者确认 priorities 顺序是否应恢复为 [multiplier, multiplier/2]。
